title: Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Cold Calling & Follow-Up
description:
Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Inbound & Outbound Lead Follow-Up

Xpert Realty Group is looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Real Estate Lead Manager / Inside Sales Assistant (ISA) to manage incoming real estate leads, conduct outbound prospecting, consistently follow up with prospects, and schedule qualified appointments for our broker and agents.

This is not a general administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us make sure no legitimate real estate opportunity falls through the cracks.

You will work primarily inside Lofty CRM and serve as the first point of contact for many new buyer and seller leads.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor Lofty during your assigned work hours for new inbound leads

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and

- Call and follow up with older leads already in our database

- Make outbound prospecting calls to potential sellers

- Work buyer and seller internet leads

- Contact expired listings, FSBOs, absentee owners, distressed-property prospects, cash-offer leads, and other seller opportunities

- Qualify leads by determining their motivation, timeline, property situation, and real estate needs

- Schedule qualified appointments for the broker or assigned agent

- Immediately escalate hot or time-sensitive opportunities

- Follow our scripts and processes while still sounding natural and conversational

- Professionally handle common objections

- Accurately document every meaningful conversation in Lofty

- Update lead status, tags, notes, follow-up dates, and tasks

- Place leads into the appropriate follow-up or nurture process

- Continue nurturing prospects who are not ready today but may buy or sell later

- Help maintain a clean, organized CRM database

- Attend training, coaching, and roleplay sessions

- Track daily activity and weekly results

Inbound Lead Responsibilities

Speed-to-lead is important to this position.

When a new lead enters Lofty during your assigned working hours, you will be expected to quickly begin the appropriate contact process.

This may include:

Call → Text →
 → Qualify → Document → Schedule or Nurture

You should be comfortable communicating with people who have recently requested information as well as prospects who may require multiple follow-up attempts before responding.

Outbound Lead Responsibilities

You will also proactively contact prospects who have not recently requested information.

These may include:

- Older CRM leads

- Expired listings

- FSBOs

- Absentee owners

- Tired landlords

- Pre-foreclosure/distressed-property leads

- Cash-offer prospects

- Homeowners identified through prospecting lists

You must be comfortable making outbound calls and hearing “no” without becoming discouraged.

What We Are Looking For

You should be:

- Reliable

- Persistent

- Organized

- Coachable

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

- Confident on the telephone

- Professional and friendly

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with repetitive follow-up

- Able to work independently

- Able to follow a defined process

- Comfortable being measured by results

Strong spoken and written English is required.

You do not need an American accent, but homeowners must be able to clearly and comfortably understand you.

CRM Discipline Is Extremely Important

Every lead interaction should result in accurate CRM documentation.

We expect meaningful notes—not simply:

“Called lead.”

A good CRM note should explain what happened and what should happen next.

For example:

“Seller may relocate in approximately 3 months. Home needs some repairs. Interested in learning retail value and may consider a cash offer. Follow up Nov. 15.”

Technical Requirements

You must have:

- Reliable computer

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- Stable high-speed internet

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Webcam

- Quiet professional workspace

title: Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager
description:
# Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager



**Company:** Opulent Credit  

**Position:** Remote Credit Repair Specialist  

**Experience Level:** Experienced — NOT Entry Level  

**Employment:** Part-Time to Start, With Opportunity to Grow  

**Industry:** Credit Repair / Consumer Credit / Financial Services



## ABOUT OPULENT CREDIT



Opulent Credit is a growing U.S.-based credit restoration and financial services company.



We are looking for an experienced, **RESULTS-DRIVEN Credit Repair Specialist** who can take ownership of the backend credit repair process and help us deliver an organized, professional, results-focused experience for every client.



This is NOT simply a data-entry or letter-generation position.



We need someone who understands credit reports, dispute processing, client file management, documentation, follow-up cycles, and progress tracking — and who can manage client accounts with minimal supervision.



## RESULTS MATTER HERE



We are specifically looking for a **results-driven specialist**.



Our clients hire us because they want meaningful improvement in their credit profiles. When inaccurate, incomplete, unverifiable, duplicate, outdated, or otherwise legitimately disputable negative information is reporting, we expect our specialist to pursue the appropriate correction or deletion diligently and professionally.



**We do not guarantee deletions.**



We do not expect you to dispute accurate information without a legitimate basis, fabricate claims, misuse identity-theft procedures, or promise outcomes that cannot legally or ethically be guaranteed.



However, when a client is **rightfully owed a correction or deletion**, we expect you to know how to identify the issue, build the appropriate dispute strategy, provide supporting documentation when available, follow up correctly, evaluate the response, and continue pursuing legitimate remedies when warranted.



Simply sending a dispute and waiting is **not enough**.



We want someone who asks:



- Why did this item remain?

- Was the dispute sufficiently specific?

- What documentation supports the client's position?

- What exactly did the bureau or furnisher investigate?

- Did the information change?

- Is the reporting now accurate and complete?

- Is an additional legitimate dispute warranted?

- Should the matter be escalated through another appropriate channel?

- What is the strongest compliant next step for this client?



You should be **persistent without being reckless**.



We want measurable results — including legitimate deletions, corrections, updated account information, removal of inaccurate personal information, resolution of reporting errors, and documented improvement across client files.



## YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is to keep every Opulent Credit client moving forward.



You should know:



- What stage every client is currently in

- What has already been disputed

- What changed on each bureau

- What was deleted, corrected, verified, or remains unresolved

- When the next action is due

- What strategy should be used next

- What documents or information are still needed

- Which cases require management attention



No client should ever sit untouched because their file was forgotten.



## CREDIT REPORT ANALYSIS



You will review and analyze consumer credit reports from:



- Experian

- Equifax

- TransUnion



You must be able to identify potentially:



- Inaccurate information

- Incomplete information

- Duplicate reporting

- Incorrect balances

- Incorrect account statuses

- Incorrect payment histories

- Incorrect dates

- Incorrect personal information

- Mixed-file information

- Unauthorized or questionable inquiries

- Collections

- Charge-offs

- Late payments

- Repossessions

- Bankruptcies

- Other potentially disputable reporting issues



You must understand the difference between legitimately disputable information and accurate information that should not be misrepresented as inaccurate.



## DISPUTE PROCESSING



You will be responsible for managing dispute cycles from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing each client's complete credit profile

- Developing an appropriate dispute strategy based on the client's actual report

- Preparing accurate and individualized disputes

- Processing bureau disputes

- Preparing appropriate furnisher/creditor disputes when applicable

- Managing personal-information disputes

- Uploading supporting documentation

- Maintaining copies of correspondence

- Tracking dispute submission dates

- Tracking expected response dates

- Reviewing bureau and furnisher responses

- Determining appropriate next steps

- Preparing subsequent dispute rounds when warranted

- Preventing unnecessary duplicate or repetitive disputes

- Escalating unusual or complicated cases to management



We do NOT want someone blindly generating the same dispute letter for every client.



Every client file must be reviewed individually.



## KNOWLEDGE EXPECTATIONS



You should have practical working knowledge of credit reporting and consumer protection requirements, including:



- Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)

- Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

- FACTA

- Consumer reporting agency dispute procedures

- Furnisher dispute procedures

- Reasonable investigation requirements

- Reinvestigation procedures

- Maximum possible accuracy principles

- Identity theft procedures

- Debt validation concepts

- Credit reporting timelines

- Deletion/reinsertion procedures

- CFPB complaint procedures

- Metro 2 reporting concepts



You do NOT need to be an attorney.



However, you must understand how these laws and standards affect legitimate credit reporting disputes and know when something should be escalated rather than making unsupported legal claims.



## CLIENT FILE MANAGEMENT



Organization is extremely important.



Every client file should contain clear documentation showing:



- Current credit profile

- Original negative items

- Current negative items

- Dispute history

- Dispute dates

- Dispute rounds

- Letters/documents submitted

- Bureau responses

- Creditor/furnisher responses

- Items deleted

- Items corrected

- Items verified

- Items remaining

- New negative items

- Score changes when available

- Required client documents

- Next recommended action

- Next follow-up date



Someone should be able to open a client's account and immediately understand exactly what has happened with that client.



## CLIENT PROGRESS REPORTING



This is one of the MOST IMPORTANT parts of this position.



Management must have visibility into the entire client base.



You will provide regular progress reports showing each client's status.



Reports should include:



**Client Name**  

**Current Dispute Round**  

**Date Last Action Was Taken**  

**Bureaus Worked**  

**Items Challenged**  

**Items Deleted/Corrected**  

**Items Remaining**  

**Score Changes, If Available**  

**Responses Received**  

**Current Status**  

**Next Recommended Action**  

**Next Action Date**  

**Documents Needed From Client**  

**Issues / Escalations / Notes**



We expect proactive reporting.



Management should NOT have to repeatedly ask:



"What's going on with this client?"



You should already know.



## WEEKLY OPERATIONS REPORT



You will also provide management with a weekly overview containing:



- Total active clients

- Clients currently in active dispute cycles

- New clients onboarded

- Disputes completed that week

- Bureau/furnisher responses received

- Total deletions/corrections recorded

- Clients awaiting responses

- Clients requiring another dispute round

- Clients waiting on documentation

- Stalled or problematic accounts

- Accounts requiring management attention

- Upcoming deadlines/actions



Accuracy is more important than making numbers look impressive.



## CLIENT ONBOARDING & QUALITY CONTROL



For new clients, you may be responsible for:



- Reviewing onboarding information

- Verifying required documents are present

- Confirming credit monitoring/report access

- Organizing client documentation

- Completing an initial credit audit

- Recording baseline credit information

- Identifying initial dispute opportunities

- Creating the initial case strategy

- Flagging missing or conflicting information before processing



Before anything is submitted, you are expected to perform quality control.



Names, addresses, account numbers, bureaus, dates, documents, and dispute reasons must be checked for accuracy.



## SOFTWARE



Experience with credit repair platforms is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- DisputeFox

- Credit Repair Cloud

- Dispute Panda

- Client Dispute Manager

- GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms

- Credit monitoring/report platforms

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Google Drive

- Project-management systems



If you have experience with DisputeFox specifically, please mention it prominently in your application.



## DATA SECURITY & CONFIDENTIALITY



You will work with sensitive consumer information.



You must:



- Maintain strict confidentiality

- Follow company security procedures

- Never download or share client information unnecessarily

- Never use client information outside authorized company systems

- Protect passwords and account credentials

- Immediately report suspected security issues

- Follow company policies regarding access to client data



Discretion and trustworthiness are mandatory.



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Results-driven**

- Extremely organized

- Detail-oriented

- Persistent

- Resourceful

- Reliable

- Proactive

- Analytical

- Consistent

- Deadline-driven

- Comfortable managing multiple client files

- Able to work independently

- Able to communicate problems before they become emergencies



We are not measuring performance solely by the number of letters sent.



We care about **case progression, legitimate deletions and corrections, accuracy, proper follow-up, documentation quality, turnaround time, and keeping clients moving toward the strongest credit profile legitimately available to them.**



You should be capable of managing a growing client caseload without allowing quality to decline.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



- 2+ years of hands-on credit repair/dispute processing experience preferred

- Experience analyzing all three major credit bureaus

- Experience managing multiple client dispute cycles

- Experience reviewing bureau responses

- Experience tracking deletions, corrections, and account changes

- Strong understanding of FCRA/FDCPA and credit reporting procedures

- Excellent written English

- Excellent organizational skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable computer and internet connection



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We prefer someone who can enter the company and contribute quickly rather than requiring extensive training on basic credit repair.



## BONUS EXPERIENCE



Strong candidates may also have experience with:



- CFPB complaints

- Furnisher disputes

- Identity theft documentation

- Secondary consumer reporting agencies

- LexisNexis

- Innovis

- SageStream

- CoreLogic

- Advanced credit report auditing

- Funding-readiness credit analysis

- Business credit

- Credit optimization



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful Credit Repair Specialist at Opulent Credit makes our backend run smoothly.



Client files are organized.



Disputes go out on schedule.



Responses are reviewed promptly.



Results are documented.



**Legitimate opportunities for deletions and corrections are pursued thoroughly.**



When the first attempt does not resolve a legitimate reporting issue, the specialist analyzes why and determines the appropriate next step rather than simply giving up.



Next actions are already planned.



Management always knows where clients stand.



Clients don't fall through the cracks.



And as our client base grows, our operational quality grows with it.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV

2. Number of years working specifically in credit repair

3. Credit repair software you have used

4. Approximate number of client files you have managed simultaneously

5. A description of your normal dispute workflow from onboarding through subsequent rounds

6. A sample of how you track/report client progress

7. Examples of legitimate deletions/corrections you have achieved, with ALL consumer personal information removed/redacted

8. Your experience with FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2 concepts, CFPB complaints, and furnisher disputes

9. Your expected hourly/monthly compensation

10. Your weekly availability



**IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST:**



At the very top of your application, write:



**OPULENT STANDARD**



Then answer this scenario:



*A client's first dispute round has returned. Two accounts were deleted, one account was corrected, three accounts were verified with no changes, and one bureau has not yet responded.*



Briefly explain:



- What you would document

- What you would report to management

- What you would review before determining the next action

- How you would approach the three verified accounts

- How you would make sure this client does not fall through the cracks



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for a **long-term, results-driven team member** who wants to grow with the company — not someone looking to complete the bare minimum.

Your job is to take a local market + target keywords, build the website properly (with Claude etc.) and most important part - get it ranking high in organic to #1 spot/first page in Google so it generates real organic traffic and phone calls.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Track results and continuously improve websites based on what is actually working

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

KEYWORD → WEBSITE → ON-PAGE SEO → CONTENT → AUTHORITY → RANKINGS → TRAFFIC → LEADS

This is an execution role.

Experience with local SEO and lead generation sites



Long-term opportunity for the right person as we scale the number of websites.



TO APPLY



Send us a message telling us about your experience with local SEO and lead-generation websites.
salary: $4/hr to start, raises based on results

title: Senior Regulatory Coordinator / Paralegal – Government Submissions (Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US



Brand Maven Consulting is a US regulatory consulting firm. We help fertilizer, animal feed, pet food, biostimulant, pest
 and seed companies get their products approved for sale in every US state.



Each state has its own rules, forms, fees and deadlines. That is 50 separate regulatory systems. Our clients count on us to get every detail right. Our approval rate across all programs is 99.3%.



Our team is remote. You will report to Esem, our Regulatory Operations & Compliance Manager. Esem is based in the Philippines.



Website: 



THE ROLE



We are hiring an experienced Senior Regulatory Coordinator. This is not a general VA role. It is senior paralegal-level work. You prepare and submit filings to government agencies, and you track the deadlines that keep our clients' products legal to sell.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Read product labels and confirm the correct product type for each state. The product type d
 the form, the fee and whether a license is needed.

- Fill out state registration forms and online state portals accurately.

- Copy label data, such as guaranteed analysis, exactly as written.

- Total registration fees and check them against each state's fee schedule.

- Run monthly renewal cycles and tonnage (sales volume) reports for each client.

- Check documents from clients. Confirm that the label changes we requested were actually made.

- Prepare filing packets and cover letters for mailing.

- Ask clients for missing information, clearly and politely.

- Spot problems early and suggest the fix, without waiting to be told.



Your application code is RC-HARBOR. You will need it to apply.



YOU MUST HAVE



- 2+ years preparing or submitting filings, reports, renewals, permits or applications to a government agency. Philippine agencies count. Examples: FDA Philippines (CPR or LTO), SEC (GIS), BIR, LGU business permits, customs, DTI, or similar.

  OR 2+ years as a paralegal or legal assistant.

- Strong attention to detail. One wrong number on a state form can cause a rejection.

- Clear written English.

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup (mobile data or a second ISP) plus a power backup plan.

- Able to work our schedule (below).



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with US clients or US government websites.

- Experience in agriculture, food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics or chemical registration.

- Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams) and PDF editing tools.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day.

- Start time: 5:00–6:00 AM Philippine time (2:00–3:00 PM US Pacific). This is a day shift in the Philippines.

- Pay: $800–1,000 USD per month, based on experience. Paid twice a month.

- 90-day performance review. 13th-month pay in December.

- Long-term role. We are growing.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply by
 only. We do not read applications sent through OnlineJobs messages.

 to:

2. Attach your resume as a PDF. Do not attach a cover letter.

3. In the body of the
, answer these questions. Number your answers 1 to 5.

   1. Describe one real filing, report or renewal you prepared for a government agency. Name the agency, the document, and how you tracked the deadline. If you are a paralegal, describe one filing you prepared.

title: Production Operations Manager - USA Construction / Home Services - Residential
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POSTING, IF YOU DON'T YOU WILL BE SCREENED OUT AUTOMATICALLY



We are an established residential home services company based in the Minneapolis–St. Paul area of the United States, and we are looking for an exceptional Production Operations Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day logistics behind our projects.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable making decisions, and capable of managing a constantly changing production schedule without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.



You will work remotely but will be responsible for coordinating U.S.-based subcontractor crews, customers, schedules, field staff, and production systems. This is a key operational role within the company, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the business.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Schedule projects and coordinate job starts

• Coordinate subcontractor crews and maintain an accurate production schedule

• Create, send, and manage work orders

• Recruit, screen, and onboard new subcontractors

• Maintain an active subcontractor roster and track availability

• Continuously build a strong pipeline of qualified subcontractors

• Make sure we have enough production capacity for upcoming work

• Monitor projects from scheduling through completion

• Solve day-to-day production and scheduling problems

• Communicate with subcontractors, customers, salespeople, and field staff

• Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

• Track project status, delays, issues, and completion

• Coordinate warranty work, punch-list items, and smaller service projects

• Coordinate with U.S.-based field staff and help ensure they are being utilized efficiently

• Coordinate quality-control visits and project inspections

• Follow up on outstanding production issues until they are fully resolved

• Build and improve systems and processes that make production easier to manage and scale



A major part of this role will be recruiting and managing our subcontractor network. We do not view recruiting as something that should only happen when we urgently need additional workers. The Production Operations Manager should continuously develop relationships with qualified subcontractors so we have enough capacity as production volume changes throughout the year.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with previous experience in operations, construction, home services, property management, logistics, dispatching, project coordination, or a similar environment.



The ideal candidate:



• Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Can manage many projects and moving pieces at the same time

• Is comfortable making decisions and solving problems independently

• Communicates extremely well in written and spoken English

• Is confident communicating with U.S. customers, contractors, and field workers

• Is comfortable holding people accountable

• Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them

• Can prioritize quickly when several issues happen at once

• Learns new software and systems quickly

• Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where schedules can change

• Has experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company

• Has experience coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other distributed workers

• Is looking for a long-term position with an opportunity to take on greater responsibility



We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between completing tasks and owning an outcome. You should be able to look at the entire production pipeline, determine what needs attention, communicate with the right people, and make sure things get done without requiring constant direction.



If we have projects starting next week, you should already be confirming subcontractor availability. If capacity is becoming tight, you should already be recruiting. If a customer or production issue develops, you should take ownership of getting it resolved. If the same type of problem keeps occurring, we want you to help improve the system so it stops happening.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, long-term position with a typical workload of approximately 40 hours per week. Some weeks may be lighter and others may require additional time depending on production volume and seasonality. Because you will be coordinating with U.S.-based customers, subcontractors, and field staff, you must be available primarily during U.S. Central Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday. This means working overnight hours in the Philippines, so please only apply if you are comfortable maintaining this schedule long term.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is $2,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience, ability, and fit. There is significant opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who performs well and becomes a key long-term member of the company.



TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Begin your application with the words "I AM YOUR NEXT PRODUCTION MANAGER" so we know you carefully read the entire posting.

2. Briefly describe your experience managing operations, projects, contractors, logistics, or schedules.

3. Describe a situation where something went wrong operationally and explain how you handled it.

4. Tell us about your experience working U.S. business hours or overnight shifts.

5. Tell us about any experience you have managing or coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other workers.

6. Include a short video introduction explaining your background and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to complete a practical operations exercise before moving forward in the hiring process.



We are looking for someone exceptional, dependable, proactive, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our company.

s to clients and government agencies.

SCHEDULE AND PAY

Apply by
 only. We do not read applications sent through OnlineJobs messages.

title: Healthcare Outreach / Lead Generation VA
description:
Healthcare Lead Generation & Outreach Specialist



Remote | Part-Time



Premier Nurse Staffing LLC is a growing healthcare staffing agency seeking a confident, organized, and professional Healthcare Lead Generation & Outreach Specialist to help us identify and connect with healthcare facilities that utilize temporary or supplemental staffing.



The primary purpose of this position is to contact healthcare facilities, gather information, identify the appropriate decision-makers, and generate qualified leads for our company to follow up with.



Responsibilities



You will:



* Research healthcare facilities within our target markets, including skilled nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, rehabilitation centers, hospitals, and other healthcare organizations.

* Make outbound calls to facilities using a provided script.

* Determine whether the facility currently uses outside staffing agencies for RN, LPN, CNA, or other healthcare staffing needs.

* Identify the person responsible for staffing or approving staffing vendors, such as the Director of Nursing, Administrator, HR Manager, Staffing Coordinator, or Procurement representative.

* Obtain the decision-maker’s name, title, phone number, extension, and
 address whenever possible.

* Ask about the facility’s process for becoming an approved staffing vendor.

* Determine whether the facility is currently accepting new staffing agencies/vendors.

* Identify current or recurring staffing needs when the facility is willing to provide that information.

* Send approved introductory
s and company information when requested.

* Schedule follow-up calls or appointments for PNS management when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate records of every facility contacted and the outcome of each call.

* Follow up with facilities that request additional information or ask to be contacted at a later date.

* Build and maintain an organized pipeline of prospective facility clients.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Speaks clear, professional English and is comfortable making outbound calls to U.S. businesses.

* Is confident speaking with receptionists, administrators, Directors of Nursing, HR departments, and other healthcare professionals.

* Has experience with cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, healthcare staffing, medical recruiting, or B2B sales.

* Is comfortable making a significant number of outbound calls.

* Can follow a script while still sounding natural and conversational.

* Is persistent without being aggressive.

* Has strong organizational and follow-up skills.

* Can accurately document call results and contact information.

* Is comfortable working independently and meeting weekly outreach goals.



Previous experience working with a U.S. healthcare staffing agency, nurse staffing company, home health agency, or medical organization is strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls. We want someone who consistently produces useful information and qualified opportunities.



Examples include:



* Identifying the correct staffing decision-maker

* Obtaining verified contact information

* Finding facilities currently using staffing agencies

* Identifying facilities accepting new staffing vendors

* Obtaining vendor-registration instructions

* Identifying facilities with current staffing needs

* Scheduling conversations with interested decision-makers



Schedule



This position will begin on a part-time basis, with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities as Premier Nurse Staffing grows.



Calls must be made during normal U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief description of your outbound calling or lead-generation experience.

2. Any experience you have working with U.S. healthcare or healthcare staffing companies.

3. The types of businesses or organizations you have cold-called previously.

4. Your hourly rate.

5. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

6. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position.



Please begin your application with the words “PNS Outreach” so we know you read the complete job description.

title: Marketing & Content Coordinator - Moving Company
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE.

We’re looking for a marketing & content coordinator to manage the daily execution of our marketing efforts. 

You will turn real moving footage, customer questions, and approved marketing ideas into consistent content that builds trust and generates qualified leads. This is not an editor role! You will send content to editor and review before you send to us. 

 Platforms you will be in charge of are IG & FB/TikTok/YT Shorts, Reddit , Website blog posts, Google Biz profile & Yelp. 

Remote & Full Time

 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Content Planning 

 A. Maintain content calendar with topics, deadlines, approvals, and publishing dates. 

 B. Gather recurring client FAQ’s to develop content ideas.

 C. Keep footage, photos, draft, and published link organized.

2. Social Media and Video Coordination

 A. Collection and organized moving footage supplied by crew.

 B. Prepare clear briefs for video editor, including footage links, intended message, platforms, and deadlines.

 C. Track editing progress, coordinate revisions, check drafts for accuracy, brand consistency, and customer privacy.

 D. Write captions and schedule approve content for IG, TikTok, Youtube shorts 

 E. Monitor comments and messages, responded with approved guidelines, and pass important inquiries to Andrew

3. Website and Community Content 

 A. Draft helpful square-space blog posts about LA to SF Moving questions, prep tips, customer concerns etc.

 B. Submit blog posts to Edgar for approval, publish approved posts, and keep information current

 C. Draft useful reddit posts and answers, following community rules. Make it sounds natural, no need to disclose biz affiliation.

 D. Track inquiries generated by these channels and pass them to the sales department.

4. Business profiles and customer reviews 

 A. Keep Google business profile and yelp info accurate

 B. Add approved moving photos to both profile every two weeks. 

 C. Monitor reviews, draft replies, and publish responses after approval.

 D. Requests for reviews is handled by operations manger BUT you will track. 

5. Referral administration and reporting.

 A. Maintain a referral contact log with follow up dates.

 B. Support approved referral follow-ups and pass referred prospects to sales or Andrew.

 C. Prepare a concise weekly update covering plush content, upcoming work, reviews, channel performance, and decisions needed.

 D. Track qualified inquiries and use booking outcomes supplied by sales. 



QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience coordinating social media, content publishing, or digital marketing for a business.

- Strong written English and English comprehension.

- Strong organization, attentive to detail.

- Familiarity with IG, TikTok, YT Shorts, Reddit, and content scheduling tools.

- Ability to coordinate with a video editor to provide clear feedback

- Sound judgement about factual claims, customer privacy, and when to request approval.

- Experience with Squarespace. Google Biz profile, Reddit, Yelp, local-service marketing, and basic SEO 



WORKING RELATIONSHIP and AUTHORITY

You will manage routine scheduling, content organization, and factual profile updates within approved guidelines. Edgar/Andrew sets marketing strategy, ad budgets, brand direction, and approval requirements, new public claims, and sensitive responses.

 A sprat video editor handles video production. Sales calls, quotes, booking, dispatch, payments, and job accounting belong to their respective roles.

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE.

- Approved Content is published consistently according the agreed calendar.

- The editor receives organized footage and clear briefs.

- Business profiles, stays accurate and current.

- Checking review request to remind operations manager.

- Every sales inquiry from these social media channels reach sales team

- Weekly reporting shows which efforts generated qualified inquiries and booked moves. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following

- Resume and short intro describing your relevant experience and how you keep content work organized

- 2-3 relevant work samples. For example a content calendar, editor brief, a video, blog posts or social media account you help manage.

- Your weekly ability and hours available for work. 

- A formal portfolio! This is brownie points. I would love to see viewable links, visuals, screenshots, pdf. Etc.



Only shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete the paid test ($5)

description:
META ADS SPECIALIST - Paid Social for Car Tech Brand (Long-term, Monthly Retainer)



ABOUT US

We run a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling smartphone integration modules (wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) for BMW, Mercedes and Audi. We sell across the US, UK and Europe and run 5-figure monthly ad spend on Meta. The founder runs every campaign personally - you start as his right hand on the account, and the role grows from there.



THE JOB

You start as a helper on the account: daily monitoring, uploading creatives, building ad sets to our specs, keeping tracking healthy. Show results and you grow into running the monitoring fully, with your own test campaigns and budget.



- Daily account check with a short read: what moved, what to watch, what you recommend and why

- Prepare launches: upload creatives, build ad sets to our specs, name things properly

- Fix and maintain tracking health: Events Manager, Conversions API, deduplication. This is your first real project and we measure it against our real sales numbers

- Audit our Meta ad account and tell us what we're missing - this is how you get hired

- Weekly summary: results, learnings, what to test next



We provide EVERYTHING: full account history, our testing doctrine and decision rules, proven creatives and scripts, past performance data, and a founder who answers fast.



The hard part of this job is not launching campaigns. It's knowing when to do nothing - reading one bad day and telling noise from a real problem, holding when holding is right, and being honest the moment something you launched isn't working. If you can admit a losing test faster than we spot it, you'll do very well here.



HOURS & PAY

About 1 hour per day, Monday to Sunday - the account runs daily, so do we

Start as a helper on the account - €300/month

Grow into monitoring it fully - €500/month and growing from there

Paid weekly via Wise



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years running Meta ads for e-commerce stores specifically - not lead gen, not local businesses

- Proven results you can show with context - account screenshots, case breakdowns, references. Show us, don't tell us

- You understand iOS tracking loss, attribution windows and CAPI, and can explain them in plain words

- Able to make small calls alone and flag big ones before touching anything

- Comfortable using AI to work faster, and smart enough to know when not to trust it

- Strong English, reachable on WhatsApp



TO APPLY

1. Describe one e-commerce account you scaled - starting point, what you changed, the result with numbers

2. Answer this: a store's real sales are double what Meta reports. What are the first three things you check?

3. Tell us your expected monthly rate for this scope

4. Start your application with the word PIXEL so we know you read this

Someone who wants to understand what makes people stop.



What makes them watch.



What makes them buy.

Not after months of creative testing.



Not after 30 variations.



Eight ads.



First week.



Tripled revenue.

You won’t be pushing pixels.



You’ll be pushing psychology.

Turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, high-intent, brain-triggering direct-response creatives.

You think like a marketer first, an editor second.

You’ll get internal creative strategy training.



You’ll get deep psychology-based marketing breakdowns.



Within months, you won’t just edit.



You’ll strategise, concept, and produce winning ads.



Why Join Us?



You’ll work with top-level strategists, creators, and growth operators.



You’ll learn real marketing psychology — the one skill that makes editors irreplaceable.



You’ll have massive long-term earning and career upside.

title: Paralegal / Legal Assistant
description:
Senior Legal Assistant / Paralegal

Full-Time • Remote • Long-Term (US Law Firm)



Sheil Law Firm, a Denver, Colorado law firm, is hiring one senior legal assistant/paralegal to work directly with the attorney.



The firm is one attorney and this seat. There is no layer of management and nowhere for work to hide. When clients trust the firm, it will often be because of something you did.



Most clients come to us on one of the hardest days of their lives: a death in the family, a child in trouble at school, or another life-changing event. They will not remember the legal work. They will remember whether someone answered, whether it was right, and whether it was done on time.



Because of that, two things matter more than anything on your résumé:



Responsiveness

When a client or the attorney contacts you during your shift, you acknowledge it promptly, even if the answer is simply:



"Received. Working on it. I'll have an update by 3."



Silence is the fastest way to fail here.



Ownership

You take tasks to completion without being chased. If you hit a roadblock, you raise it immediately. If a deadline is at risk, the attorney hears it from you first.



“I was waiting to hear back" is not a status update. Following up is part of the job.



Beyond those two principles, the standard is simple: clients feel taken care of, work is accurate, and records stay current. If it isn't in the system, it didn't happen.



We hire for temperament as much as skill. If you need every task assigned, prioritized, and explained before you begin, this role is probably not a fit.



What You Get Back



We are building this firm and want someone who wants to build it with us.



Your work will be visible and meaningful. In return, you get an attorney who backs you, pays on time, values initiative, and rewards contribution. We are looking for someone who wants a seat they can grow into and keep for years.



Practice Areas



The paralegal will primarily support matters involving:



- Estate planning (wills, trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives)

- Probate and estate administration

- Guardianships and conservatorships

- Guardian ad Litem representation

- Juvenile, family, and paternity matters

- Education and special-needs advocacy

- Elder law and adult-protection matters



The firm may also handle selected matters in other practice areas, including personal injury, civil litigation, administrative proceedings, and related legal matters. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new processes and supporting work across multiple practice areas as the firm's needs evolve.



Responsibilities



Documents

- Prepare estate planning documents from attorney notes and firm templates

- Draft court filings, GAL reports, correspondence, and other legal documents for attorney review

- Proofread and redline documents for accuracy and consistency

- Assemble signing packages and coordinate witness/notary logistics



Client Management

- Respond to client communications the same day

- Conduct intake calls and gather missing information

- Keep clients informed about the status of their matter

- Escalate issues requiring attorney judgment



Records and Systems

- Maintain complete and current client files across firm systems

- Create and update matters, contacts, and client records

- Save and organize documents using firm naming conventions

- Perform conflict checks

- File and organize matter-related
s



Court and Matter Preparation

- Calendar hearings, deadlines, reviews, and signings

- Prepare hearing files and summaries

- Organize records, exhibits, and case history

- Research and summarize materials as assigned



Billing and Reporting

- Enter time and expenses

- Assist with monthly billing

- Provide regular status updates on active matters



Other Responsibilities

• Support firm operations, marketing, social media, technology, and special projects as needed

• Help improve systems, processes, and client experience

• Perform other duties reasonably related to the operation and growth of the firm



You May Be a Strong Fit If



- You notice details others miss

- You can manage dozens of active files without losing track of deadlines

- You learn processes quickly and retain them

- The attorney can assign you a task and stop thinking about it

- Your first drafts need editing, not rewriting

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You stay calm under pressure and own mistakes quickly

- You are looking for a long-term position, not your next position



Requirements



- 3+ years of legal assistant or paralegal experience, **or** a Bachelor of Laws/JD and membership in good standing with the Philippine Bar

- College degree

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage deadlines and files with minimal supervision



Only applicants meeting all requirements will be considered.



Preferred



- Experience in estate planning, probate, family law, juvenile law, personal injury, or litigation support

- Experience with HubSpot, ClickUp, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or legal practice-management software

- Comfort using AI tools for drafting, organization, and research



Schedule and Equipment



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time.  In Manila that is 10pm–7am (11pm–8am from November to mid-March). We are stating that plainly up front rather than discovering a mismatch in month two. The schedule is fixed, and this has to be your only job.

- This must be your only job

- Work is performed on a firm computer via remote desktop

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Backup power source

- Quiet private workspace

- Webcam, headset, and dual-monitor setup



Compensation



- $6.00-$8.00 USD per hour to start, depending on experience, qualifications, and interview performance

- Paid biweekly

- Compensation reviews at 6 and 12 months

- Paid US holidays

- Paid time off after probation



We are more interested in finding the right person than the cheapest person. Exceptional candidates may start at the upper end of the range.



Confidentiality



You will handle sensitive information, including estate planning documents, financial records, and information involving minors.



All work is performed under the supervision of a licensed US attorney on firm systems. A confidentiality agreement is required. This position does not involve providing legal advice.



How to Apply



 with the subject line:



**SENIOR LEGAL — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. Your résumé

2. Confirmation that you can work 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time and that this will be your only job

3. Your available start date and compensation expectations

4. Answers to the three questions below in your own words

5. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you



Questions



a. A client
s asking for a status update on her case. You check the file, the CRM, and the
 history. Nothing has been recorded in three weeks, and the attorney is in court all day. What do you do, and what do you write back to her?



b. You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



c. You open a new client's file to draft her trust and find no folder in Drive, no matter in the case system, and an intake sheet with two different dates of birth. Nobody has assigned you anything. What do you do?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid skills assessment before a final interview. We reply to every finalist.

title: Mobile Game Playtester / QA - Gold Below (iPhone or Android, Paid Trial)
description:
Help us improve Gold Below, a dark-fantasy loot roguelike for mobile.



We're looking for playtesters who can tell us what feels fun, confusing, frustrating or broken on a real iPhone or Android phone. This is a short paid testing gig. Clear observations and useful bug reports matter more than finding a large number of bugs.



PAID TRIAL AND RATE

The initial trial is up to two paid hours total, including setup, gameplay, screen recording and a short written report. Please quote your hourly rate in USD. We will agree on your rate, scope, start time and test access before you begin. Reporting time is paid and included in the two-hour limit. No unpaid test or game purchase is required. Further sessions may be offered, but ongoing hours are not guaranteed.



WHAT TO TEST

- Start fresh and tell us whether the goal, controls and first few decisions are clear.

- Try combat, inventory management, loot and upgrades. Note confusing labels, hard-to-read text or awkward touch controls.

- Check save/resume by closing and reopening the game and by moving it to the background.

- Note crashes, freezes, visual problems, lost progress or performance issues.

- Give honest feedback on difficulty, pacing and whether you want to keep playing.



DELIVERABLES WITHIN THE TWO HOURS

- Record the first 15-20 minutes on your phone with spoken observations in English. Say what you expect, what confuses you and why you make decisions. No face camera or polished video editing is needed.

- Continue testing, then send a short report prioritizing your most useful findings.

- For each bug, include the phone model, OS and game version, steps to reproduce, expected versus actual behavior, and a screenshot or video timestamp when possible.

- Include a short summary of what worked, what did not and what you would improve first. There is no minimum bug count.



REQUIREMENTS

- Access to a real iPhone or Android phone, with permission to install a provided test build.

- Ability to record the phone screen with microphone audio.

- Clear written and spoken English for feedback.

- Familiarity with mobile games. Roguelike or turn-based game experience and previous QA work are useful but not essential for thoughtful playtesting.

- A stable connection to download the build and share your recording.



TO APPLY

Use the subject: Gold Below Playtester

1. List your phone model(s), OS version(s), and available screen-recording method.

2. State your hourly rate in USD and availability for a two-hour trial.

3. Briefly describe your testing experience and name two games you play, including what you like or dislike about them.

4. If you already have a bug report or narrated testing sample, share it. Do not create new unpaid work to apply.



We want candid product feedback; no public store review or positive rating is requested.

We're a growing agency built on one simple philosophy: great people should be trusted to do great work.

Application Process (Important)

title: Senior Construction Estimator (Bid Review, Pricing, Estimating Lead)
description:
We're a US commercial landscape and irrigation contractor working in multiple states. We need a senior estimator to lead our estimating department. Our takeoff specialist handles most of the takeoffs and detail work; you'll take each bid from there and make sure it's complete, accurate and priced right before it goes out.



What you'll do:

- Review takeoffs for accuracy and completeness

- Read every relevant spec section and addendum carefully so nothing is missed

- Set and check pricing, labor, material costs and margins

- Request, compare and level subcontractor and supplier quotes

- Do the final review on every bid before submission

- Help d
 which bids we pursue

- Lead and check the work of our takeoff staff

We'll train you on our pricing and processes, but you'll own the estimating function.



Requirements:

- 10+ years of construction estimating (general construction is fine; landscape, irrigation or site work is a plus)

- Experience estimating for US clients, or clients in countries with similar bidding (Canada, Australia, etc.)

- Strong at reading plans, specs and addenda, and at catching scope gaps

- Experience with PlanSwift or similar. We use ZZTakeoff, which is very similar to PlanSwift.

- Comfortable with Excel, Adobe Acrobat, 
 and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok)

- Able to work independently and own results without being micromanaged

- At least 2-4 hours of overlap daily with US Mountain Time

- Clear written English and reliable internet



To apply, start with the word "ADDENDUM" and answer:

1. How many years have you worked as an estimator, and for what types of contractors and clients (which countries)?

2. Tell us about a bid where you caught a missed scope item, spec requirement or addendum change. What was it, and what would it have cost?

3. Walk us through how you review someone else's takeoff and estimate before it goes out.

4. How do you compare and level sub or supplier quotes that don't cover the same scope?

5. What takeoff and estimating software have you used, and for how long?

6. What hours (in Philippine time) can you work?

7. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

8. Share a Google Drive (or similar) link to 1-3 sample estimates or proposals you prepared or oversaw.

title: Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator
description:
Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



About Character Companies



Character Companies is a fast-growing residential homebuilding and real estate development company based in Northern Virginia, USA.



We build new homes throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area and are looking for an exceptional Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator to join our team remotely.



You will work directly with our Pre-Construction Manager and help manage permitting, utilities, consultants, and pre-construction activities across a growing portfolio of residential construction projects.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



This is a project coordination role for someone who is organized, persistent, proactive, comfortable on the phone, and operates with a strong sense of urgency.



Your primary objective will be to help us reduce the amount of time it takes to get our homes permitted and ready for construction.



Our Core Values



Our culture is extremely important to us. Everyone at Character Companies is expected to live our three core values:



FAIL FORWARD

We move quickly, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.



FIGURE IT OUT

We are resourceful. When we encounter a problem, we don't simply report it - we work to find the solution.



FUEL THE VIBE

We bring positive energy, communicate well, support our teammates, and make the people around us better.



These aren't just words on a wall. They influence how we hire, work, evaluate performance, and grow our team.



Your Mission



Drive down our pre-construction and permitting cycle time.



We don't want someone who simply tracks how long things are taking.



We want someone who helps make them take less time.



That requires urgency, organization, persistence, excellent follow-up, and strong communication.



If a permit isn't moving, find out why.



If a reviewer hasn't responded, follow up.



If an engineer owes us a revision, call them.



If a utility application is sitting in a queue, determine what is needed to move it forward.



If you can't solve something yourself, identify the problem clearly and escalate it to our Pre-Construction Manager.



Nothing should sit because nobody followed up.



What You'll Own



Permitting & Government Coordination



Track building, demolition, grading, trade, right-of-way, and other permits across multiple residential projects.



Monitor government permitting portals daily.



Prepare and submit permit applications and supporting documentation.



Track review deadlines, comments, corrections, resubmissions, and approvals.



Call and
 government reviewers to obtain updates and resolve outstanding items.



Coordinate responses between architects, engineers, surveyors, consultants, and our internal team.



Schedule inspections and track corrections through completion.



Maintain accurate documentation of submissions, conversations, approvals, and outstanding requirements.



Utility Coordination



Initiate and track electric, gas, water, sewer, and telecommunications applications.



Communicate directly with U.S. utility companies.



Follow up regarding utility designs, work orders, inspections, meter installations, and service activation.



Track required payments, documents, easements, load information, and approvals.



Identify stalled utility requests and proactively work to get them moving.



Pre-Construction Coordination



Maintain our master pre-construction schedule and tracker across all active projects.



Track architects, engineers, surveys, civil plans, permits, utilities, and other pre-construction deliverables.



Follow up with outside consultants on upcoming and overdue deliverables.



Maintain organized project records and correspondence.



Maintain a database of government reviewers, inspectors, utility representatives, engineers, and consultants.



Identify potential delays before they affect the project schedule.



Provide our Pre-Construction Manager with clear updates on projects requiring his attention.



Phone Communication Is a Major Part of This Position



You must be comfortable picking up the phone.



You will regularly call:



Government permitting departments



Permit reviewers



Utility companies



Architects



Engineers



Surveyors



Consultants



Vendors



Excellent spoken English is therefore extremely important.



We're looking for someone who can confidently and professionally have a conversation, ask good questions, obtain clear answers, and respectfully push for the next action.



If you strongly prefer communicating only through
 or messaging, this position will not be a good fit.



Who We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented



Highly responsive with a strong sense of urgency



Persistent without being unprofessional



Proactive and resourceful



An excellent English speaker



A strong written communicator



Confident making outbound phone calls



Comfortable managing many projects and deadlines simultaneously



Comfortable learning unfamiliar processes



Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense



Able to identify problems and propose solutions



Comfortable holding outside consultants accountable to deadlines



Able to determine when an issue needs to be escalated



We especially value people who naturally think:



"What can I do to move this forward today?"



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly valuable:



U.S. residential construction



Homebuilding



Construction project coordination



Permitting



Architecture or engineering



Utility coordination



Real estate development



Construction administration



Working remotely for a U.S.-based construction company



Previous U.S. permitting experience is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly and demonstrates strong ownership.



Technology



You should be highly comfortable using technology and learning new software.



Our team uses platforms including:



JobTread



CompanyCam



Google Workspace



Microsoft Office



Government permitting portals



Utility provider portals



Cloud-based project management systems



How We Will Measure Success



This is an outcomes-driven position.



We will measure things including:



Permit cycle time



Days from submission to approval



Speed of responses to review comments



Outstanding permit items



Utility application and activation timelines



Consultant turnaround times



Accuracy of project tracking



Number of issues proactively identified and resolved



Ultimately, your performance comes down to one question:



Are our projects moving through pre-construction faster and more predictably because you're here?



Schedule



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



You must be willing to work primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours because you will communicate directly with U.S. government agencies, utility companies, consultants, and our internal team.



Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.



We are looking for a long-term team member with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as Character Companies continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a short cover letter answering the questions below.



Generic or AI-generated cover letters that do not specifically answer these questions will not be considered.



1. Driving Down Permit Cycle Time



Your primary responsibility is to help Character Companies reduce the amount of time it takes to move a new home through permitting and into construction.



If you were given responsibility for 20 residential projects in various stages of permitting, what specific actions and systems would you implement to drive our average permitting cycle time down?



Be specific. We want to understand how you think.



2. Sense of Urgency



Tell us about a previous situation where something was delayed or wasn't moving quickly enough.



What did you personally do to move it forward?



3. Phone Communication



This position requires frequent outbound calls to U.S. government agencies, utility companies, engineers, architects, and consultants.



Describe your experience making professional outbound phone calls in English. Are you comfortable calling someone repeatedly when necessary to obtain an answer or move something forward?



4. Organization



Imagine you're responsible for tracking 20 projects, 40+ permit applications, multiple utility applications, and several outside consultants.



How would you organize your work so that nothing gets missed?



5. Figure It Out



You call a government permitting department about an application that hasn't moved in two weeks. The person tells you:



"It's still under review. Someone will contact you when it's ready."



What would you do next?



6. Relevant Experience



Tell us about any experience you have with:



Construction



Permitting



Project coordination



Utilities



Architecture/engineering



Real estate development



U.S.-based companies



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and confirm that you are available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

title: Meta ads media buyer
description:
Hello!



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to handle the daily launching of new ads in our Meta 
/Instagram) ad accounts. This is an execution role, not a media buying role. Strategy, budgets, and creative are handled on our side. You'll get everything ready to go and follow clear SOPs.



What you'll do each day



Launch 2–3 new ad concepts per day by duplicating existing campaign/ad set structures and swapping in the new creatives, copy, headlines, and links we provide.

Double-check every launch before publishing: correct ad account, naming convention, URL and UTM parameters, pixel/tracking, placements, and budget settings, all per our SOP.

Post a short end-of-day update in Slack covering what was launched, what was turned off, and anything that looked off.



Time commitment



Around 1–2 hours per day, 7 days per week. Launches should be done by noon CET. We expect this to be ongoing work if it's a good fit.



What we're looking for



You should have hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager, including duplicating campaigns/ad sets, uploading creatives, and editing ads. Most importantly, you need to be meticulous and follow SOPs exactly, since a single mistake (wrong link, wrong budget) costs money. You should also be consistent and reliable, because this happens every day, and communicate clearly and promptly if something breaks or doesn't add up.



To apply

A short summary of your Meta Ads Manager experience.

Your availability and timezone.

The answer to this question: "What would you check before hitting publish on a new ad?"

Max

title: Mortgage Broker Assistant (Loan Processor) – Australian Residential Lending – Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established mortgage broking firm based in Adelaide, South Australia. We help clients across Australia with residential home loans, mostly refinances, purchases and pre-approvals, plus some other lending. Our head broker has 7 years of broking experience and focuses on bringing in business, while our support team takes each file from the point a client commits through to settlement.

We are growing and are looking for a reliable, experienced assistant to join the team on a long-term, stable basis.



THE ROLE

You will work alongside our in-house team and take ownership of loan files from start to finish. Once a client has committed and documents are in, the file is yours to run, with the broker overseeing along the way. You will manage around 15-20 files at a time, and sometimes more, and help support our in-house staff where needed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



 • Run borrowing capacity and serviceability scenarios and shop lender options using Quickli

 • Assess client income and prepare scenarios across multiple lenders

 • Build loan applications in Apply Online and our CRMs

 • Collect and check all required client documents so each application is complete and correct

 • Prepare and lodge loan applications with lenders

 • Get forms and disclosures signed by clients

 • Liaise with clients, banks and BDMs from lodgement through to settlement

 • Follow up on conditions, additional information requests and valuations

 • Keep every deal on track against client and settlement deadlines

 • Keep client records and file notes accurate and up to date in HubSpot and MyCRM

 • Provide friendly, professional customer service by phone,
 and messaging

 • Communicate clearly with the broker and team in Slack



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



 • Proven experience processing or lodging residential mortgages for Australian lenders, including dealing directly with banks and clients (we need someone who can hit the ground running)

 • Hands-on experience building applications in Apply Online or a similar mortgage application platform

 • Working knowledge of Australian lending concepts: serviceability, living expenses, documentation requirements, pre-approvals, refinancing and settlement processes

 • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to spot missing or inconsistent documents before lodgement

 • Excellent written and spoken English

 • Able to manage multiple files at once and prioritise deadlines without close supervision

 • Strong customer service skills, with a calm, professional manner with clients and lenders

 • Comfortable handling confidential client financial information and following security procedures (strong passwords, multi-factor authentication, no sharing of logins or documents outside our systems)

 • Reliable high-speed internet with a backup option (mobile data, secondary connection or power backup), plus a quiet, dedicated workspace and your own working computer



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



 • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

 • Experience with MyCRM

 • Experience with Quickli or other mortgage scenario and borrowing capacity tools

 • Experience working with Australian banks, non-bank lenders and BDMs

 • Previous customer service or client-facing experience

 • Familiarity with Slack and remote team collaboration



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



We will train you on our own processes, systems and standards, so you do not need to know everything on day one. We want someone who already understands mortgage processing and can get up to speed quickly. You will have direct access to the broker and the in-house team.



WHAT WE OFFER



 • Full-time, long-term, stable role with an established Australian company

 • Opportunity to grow within the company

 • Supportive team and clear processes

 • Modern tools, including AI-assisted scenario tools



WORKING HOURS



Full-time, Monday to Friday, with hours that overlap Adelaide business hours. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the words "Lodgement Experience" so we know you've read this post. Then send:

 1. Your resume

 2. A short summary of your experience with Australian mortgage lodgements, including which lenders and platforms you have used

 3. The systems you are experienced with (Apply Online, HubSpot, MyCRM, Quickli or similar)

 4. Roughly how many files you managed at one time in your last role

 5. Your availability and expected rate

 6. A screenshot of your internet speed test and a short description of your backup internet and power setup



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a short practical task. 



Applications that do not follow these steps may not be reviewed.



Salary can vary depending on your skills and experience. Strictly looking for someone who has existing experience in Australian mortgage broking. 



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Virtual Producer & Content Pipeline Manager ($800 - $1,000 USD/mo)
description:
FULL-TIME: 

Salary: $800 - $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience) + Performance increases. Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week)



The Role:

I am a Real Estate Division Director in Singapore. I have a fully equipped studio, the industry expertise, and all the AI tools. What I do not have is the desire to sit alone in an empty room trying to project energy into a dead camera lens.



I am looking for a full-time Virtual Producer and showrunner. This is not a passive Video Editor or standard Virtual Assistant role. I need an assertive, intelligent pipeline manager who will tell me where to sit, what we are talking about today, and hold me accountable to producing content.



Who You Are:

You are a sparring partner, not an order-taker. If you need to be told exactly what to do every step of the way, you will fail here. I need someone sharp enough to hold a conversation and push back when needed.

You know how to "manage up." You are not intimidated by a busy boss. If I am making excuses or missing deadlines, you are comfortable calling me out and getting us back on track.

You are a systems thinker. You know how to take one piece of core content and turn it into ten pieces of micro-content using AI.



What You Will Do:

The Prep (Research): You will use AI to scrape competitor content and trends, extract what works, and build simple ad-lib outlines for me (Hook, 3 Main Points, Data/Evidence, Call to Action). No word-for-word teleprompter scripts. You must be smart enough to know when AI output is generic garbage and refine it into a sharp angle.



The Shoot (Directing): 

This is the most important part. You will be on Zoom/Riverside with me live while I shoot. You will ask me the questions, direct the flow, and give me a real human to talk to so the energy stays high.



The Multiplication (Post-Production): 

After the shoot, you own the distribution matrix. You will use AI tools to chop the video into clips, write LinkedIn posts, draft
 newsletters, and format captions for my final approval.



The Onboarding (The "Taste Transfer"):

We won't guess what works. For the first month, we will have a daily Zoom call where we review competitor videos together. I will tell you exactly what I love and what I hate until my "taste" becomes your taste.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

I do not care about generic cover letters or standard CVs. To apply, you must submit exactly two things:



A 1-to-2 minute Loom video. In this video, look at the camera and tell me exactly how you would handle a boss who constantly makes excuses for why they haven't filmed their content this week.



A Sample Outline. Find one real estate or business short-form video on TikTok/Instagram that performed well. Send me the link to the video, and below it, break it down into the outline format I need: Hook, 3 Main Points, Evidence, Call to Action.



Applications missing either of these two items will be immediately archived

The style and quality of content we are looking for is similar to:











Please look through these pages before applying so you fully understand the type of videos, filming style and overall aesthetic we are looking for.



The invitation templates are already designed and built.



You will be provided with the finished design and all of the elements required, including:



- Images

- Graphics

- Fonts

- Colours

- Text

- Decorative elements

- Final design reference
